purpose: Machinery required per business, with role, investment category, automation level and whether it is essential.
collection_mode: Knowledge synthesis from documented public sources (WebFetch to government domains blocked by environment egress policy)
methodology: Every business carries at least one machinery row, enforced by V11, including the asset-light ones where the requirement is IT infrastructure rather than plant. Where the machine already exists in Package005's farm_machinery dataset -- rice mill, dal mill, oil expeller, cold storage, solar dryer, packaging machine, cold chain, agricultural drone -- it is referenced by machinery_id rather than restated. That is the normalization rule applied at row level.
known_limitations: No machinery cost is asserted: investment_category gives an ordinal band (Core Plant, Ancillary, Tooling, IT Infrastructure, Premises) instead. Machine names outside the Package005 scope carry the sentinel in package005_machinery_id, which means only that Package005 does not hold that machine, not that it is unimportant. Machinery lists are indicative of a typical configuration, not an exhaustive bill of plant.
